grain.kind: one Urdu sentence from the book's prose with one key word blanked: a name, place, event or practice

slots.prompt_rule: Five one-line Urdu sentences from the included chapters, each with one blank (____) for a single word or name the book states; `answer` = that word. Never quote, complete, or ask the child to write the text of any ayat, hadith, dua or durood, nor its translation, and never write Arabic: ask about meaning, events, people and practice as the book explains them in Urdu. No true/false items, in any form.

grain.kind: one point per item across the included chapters: beliefs, worship, seerah, morals, personalities

slots.prompt_rule: Fifteen four-option Urdu MCQs spread across chapters 2–7, at least two from each chapter. Never quote, complete, or ask the child to write the text of any ayat, hadith, dua or durood, nor its translation, and never write Arabic: ask about meaning, events, people and practice as the book explains them in Urdu. No true/false items, in any form.

slots.teacher_note_en: Write the dua of Ibrahim (AS) or the durood from the book in this space before photocopying. The child translates it.
slots.teacher_note_ur: فوٹو کاپی سے پہلے کتاب سے حضرت ابراہیمؑ کی دعا یا درود شریف اس جگہ استاد خود لکھیں۔ بچہ اس کا ترجمہ کرے۔
slots.key_note_en: The teacher marks the translation against the book’s translation of the text she wrote.
slots.key_note_ur: استاد اپنی لکھی ہوئی عبارت کا ترجمہ کتاب کے ترجمے کے مطابق جانچیں۔

slots.instruction_ur: کوئی سے {w:پانچ} سوالات کے مختصر جوابات لکھیں۔

grain.kind: a short answer of three or four sentences on one lesson

slots.prompt_rule: Eight short Urdu questions, each from a different lesson of chapters 2–7; `answer` = four points the book states. Never quote, complete, or ask the child to write the text of any ayat, hadith, dua or durood, nor its translation, and never write Arabic: ask about meaning, events, people and practice as the book explains them in Urdu. No true/false items, in any form.

slots.instruction_ur: کوئی سے {w:دو} سوالات کے تفصیلی جوابات لکھیں۔

grain.kind: a detailed answer on one lesson: an event, a teaching and its lesson for us

slots.prompt_rule: Five detailed Urdu questions, each from a different chapter, none on a lesson Q4 asks; `answer` = five points the book states. Never quote, complete, or ask the child to write the text of any ayat, hadith, dua or durood, nor its translation, and never write Arabic: ask about meaning, events, people and practice as the book explains them in Urdu. No true/false items, in any form.

lines_en: MCQs: 1 mark for the letter. Two circles or an overwritten answer = 0.
M = method · A = answer · U = unit · K = key point · L = label.
"Attempt any N": tell children to answer exactly N. If more are answered, mark all and keep the best N.
lines_ur: معروضی: درست حرف پر 1 نمبر۔ دو دائرے یا اوور رائٹنگ = 0۔
M = طریقہ، A = جواب، U = اکائی، K = اہم نکتہ، L = نام
«کوئی سے N»: بچوں کو بالکل N سوال حل کرنے کو کہیں۔ زیادہ حل ہوں تو سب جانچ کر بہترین N رکھیں۔

Photocopy the question paper, all {n} pages, one per child.
You add: {duty} on the question paper, page {p} (book p. {b}).
Mark question by question across all copies, not copy by copy.

سوالیہ پرچے کے تمام {n} صفحات کی فوٹو کاپی کریں، ہر بچے کے لیے ایک۔
شامل کریں: {duty}، سوالیہ پرچہ صفحہ {p} (کتاب ص {b})۔
